🕯️ Luz Bianchi is dead — the night. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Luz kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
The village's quarrel was with Luz — and Luz is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
At the grave, Riley speaks for Luke — "Luz trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
That night, they bring Luz home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
